neighbours.label: digits of a 21st-century year (2010s etc.), the side of a date distinction whose other pole fires on 19xx years
fire: The museum reopened to visitors in the summer of 2014 after repairs.
The council finally approved the new budget in 2013 after months of debate.
Her first novel was published in 2016 by a small press.
The company launched its tablet in the autumn of 2011.
We moved to Denver in early 2018 for my new job.
The study was conducted between 2010 and 2012 in rural clinics.
The annual picnic was first held in 2015 at the lake.
The bridge was finally completed in 2017, two years late.
quiet: The museum reopened to visitors in the summer of 1954 after repairs.

The company launched its radio in the autumn of 1981.
We moved to Denver in early 1978 for my new job.

notes: Card: + pole peaks on the last digit of 201x and on date positions; - pole peaks on the '9' of 19xx. Output promotes AI, Biden, COVID (recency). Month-day dates avoided because the + pole also fires on the space before a day number.
